answer: Make each identity prove a separate vantage by answering unpredictable beacons from three distant relays at once: round-trip times are bounded by signal speed, so clones sharing one host cannot fake being on another island — their timings coincide and collapse into one claim. A zephyr-swift reply from the wrong distance is physically impossible, not just costly. To pass, a farmer must run real machines in real places for every name, so scale stops being free software and becomes distributed infrastructure.
